files.date: 2 May 1561 ("Datum door bewerker bepaald", editorially assigned from Japikse's edition; letter itself undated)
files.correspondent: to Günther van Schwarzburg, from Brussel (Bruxelles)
files.shelfmark: Staatsarchiv Rudolstadt, Kanzlei Sondershausen 693 o.s. (na f. 26), per the image's own archive stamp
files.archive_bronnen_codes: JC ; SAR (not resolved to full names by the harvest worker; SAR plausibly Staatsarchiv Rudolstadt per this page's own caption)
files.printed_edition: Japikse, N., ed. Correspondentie van Willem den Eerste, prins van Oranje. Eerste deel (1551-1561) ('s-Gravenhage 1934), letter no. 316, pp.343-344 -- read directly this pass (images/japikse_p343.png, japikse_p344.png); prints only the clear opening and stops before the ciphered majority of the letter, see NOTES.md
files.status: target, 'Grotendeels in cijfer' per WVO Opmerkingen, no solution word; confirmed by eye this pass -- p.1 opens in clear German prose then switches to a German nomenclator: doubled/tripled letters (aa, cc, dd, hs, xr) mixed with 2-digit numbers, a different and more complex system than the pure-numeral French Nassau-Oranje ciphers
